title: ICS23 Proof Verifier
description: Offline verifier for ICS23 declarative Merkle proofs. Paste an ExistenceProof or NonExistenceProof in proofs.proto JSON shape (base64 or 0x-hex byte fields, enum names or numbers), supply the commitment root and the key being claimed, and pick one of three build-time-pinned ProofSpec presets (iavl, tendermint, smt). The page recomputes the Merkle root and every spec-conformance check entirely client-side and names the specific check that failed. There is no free-text ProofSpec input by design: a spec supplied alongside the proof it constrains could declare a forged shape legal, which is the shape of the October 2022 VSA-2022-103 forged-membership finding. Verify-only, no prover, zero network calls.

proofInput.description: ExistenceProof or NonExistenceProof JSON in proofs.proto shape, optionally wrapped in a CommitmentProof envelope

rootInput.description: Commitment root the proof must verify against, hex

keyInput.description: Key whose presence or absence is being claimed

specInput.description: Pinned ProofSpec preset: iavl, tendermint or smt

verification_report.description: PASS or FAIL verdict from verifyExistence/verifyNonExistence plus a per-step check list naming the exact failing check

mcp_tool_definition.name: verify_ics23_proof
mcp_tool_definition.description: Verifies an ICS23 existence or non-existence Merkle proof against a commitment root and one of three pinned ProofSpec presets (iavl, tendermint, smt), entirely offline in the browser. Returns a PASS or FAIL verdict and names the specific check that failed.
